decisions.reason: The dismantling joint fits the core fittings range and costs little to keep listed, but it was not observed in 2020 to 2021, which suggests weak traction and raises the risk of withdrawal.
The pipe bracket uses existing fabrication capabilities at low carrying cost, so the option is worth holding even though its visibility has faded since 2018.

The powder-coated public waste bin is a cheap diversification option that uses existing coating equipment and sells to municipal customers the firm already serves, so it is worth keeping despite the distance from the core.
The waste bin with ashtray adds several models and so costs more to carry, and its niche is narrowing, but its value is not yet clearly disproven.
Outdoor ashtrays sit furthest from the core in a shrinking market and carry a multi-model line, so withdrawal risk is highest, but the option stays open because it shares production with the bins.
